geometry.note: 'verified' because representation is 'surveyed' from a rank 9 project_document (≤ 10, A15/A25), independent of any OSM check. Coordinate given to 0.01 arcsecond in the source (implying sub-metre nominal precision); accuracy_m is nonetheless set to 30 m, a conservative honest figure for a government-published DMS coordinate of unstated survey method.
geometry.quote: Il Centro direzionale e i Laboratori Esterni sono localizzati dalle coordinate: 42°25'13.56"N – 13°30'59.33"E (WGS 84)

name: LNGS Centro Direzionale / External Laboratories (surveyed point)
notes: This point is 79.6 m from the vertex-averaged centroid of the independently-georeferenced OSM building geometry:lngs-external-labs-boundary, corroborating both (see the facility worklog).

This is the surface administrative complex, not the underground halls; it should not be used to correct site:lngs-hall-a/-b/-c's own coordinates (those are 'kind: underground_lab' records and this point is 'kind: campus'-equivalent, at the surface, several kilometres from the halls by tunnel). See geometry:lngs-hall-a/-b/-c and the worklog for the underground correction instead.

summary.plain: The government-surveyed location of LNGS's surface offices and support buildings at Assergi, from the laboratory's official external emergency plan.
